task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate the robot to the CUP, pick it up, then navigate to the TABLE and place the CUP.
assumptions: The CUP is graspable by the CAR robot.
The CAR robot can navigate safely to the specified coordinates.
rtdl: def task PickAndPlaceCUP(;){ state nav_success1: bool; state nav_msg1: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav_success2: bool; state nav_msg2: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav_success1, message->nav_msg1); check(nav_success1 == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP"; success->pick_success, message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=-2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav_success2, message->nav_msg2); check(nav_success2 == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP", location_name="TABLE"; success->place_success, message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
